Amandine Hesse ( French pronunciation: [amɑ̃din ɛs] ; born 16 January 1993) is a French professional tennis player. Hesse has won six singles and eight doubles titles on the ITF Circuit . On 9 May 2016, she reached her career-high WTA singles ranking of No. 154. On 2 May 2016, she peaked at world No. 108 in the doubles rankings. Playing for the France Fed Cup team , Hesse has a win–loss record of 3–1. Hesse at the 2014 Open de Cagnes-sur-Mer Hesse in 2015 Personal life [ edit ] Amandine Hesse was born in Montauban and started playing tennis at the age of five. She is coached by father, Yannick Hesse. Her mother's name is Nicole . She has two half-sisters, Géraldine and Stéphanie.
